original_problem.statement: The Riemann hypothesis: every nontrivial zero of the Riemann zeta function has real part 1/2.
original_problem.priority: The 2026 unconditional simple-critical proportion is due to Alpoge-Furman (argument found by Claude, arXiv:2608.13637), with Lamzouri's direct proof (arXiv:2609.02882) and Wang's short-interval and global extensions (arXiv:2609.07918, arXiv:2609.24167).
original_problem.prohibited_reframing: No proportion theorem, finite certificate, DOI or release may be described as progress toward proving or disproving RH itself.

mission: Prove independently checkable improvements of zero-proportion theorems, chiefly positive proportions of simple critical zeros in short intervals (T,T+T^theta], with exact or certified arithmetic, attributed inputs kept explicit, and one manuscript home per validated theorem.

focuses.title: Source audit and baseline reproduction
focuses.target: Reproduce the 2026 baseline constants and normalizations and audit the proof and formalization scope.
focuses.value: A trusted baseline without claiming priority.
focuses.success_gate: Exact reproduction of the published constants and an algebraic audit.
stop_conditions: A published constant fails exact reproduction.

focuses.title: Short-interval stability, parity and localization
focuses.target: Strengthen the short-interval simple-critical curve and move its positivity onset through finite Hilbert, parity, Selberg and spectral-defect transfers.
focuses.value: Every-interval statements are stronger than global averages and were not covered by the external sources.
focuses.success_gate: A proved onset below Wang's cosine threshold with certified constants.
stop_conditions: The onset stops moving under second-order refinements.
A located prior source proves the same transfer.
focuses.novelty_status: No exact overlap found in the recorded primary-source searches; external expert confirmation pending. The rank-six constant is an attributed input.

focuses.title: Global three-point kernel sharpening
focuses.target: Replace the non-sharp auxiliary ratio in Wang's global framework by its sharp value.
focuses.value: A sharp theorem and a global proportion above Wang's printed bound.
focuses.success_gate: Proof of R(alpha,beta)<=sqrt(2) with equality cases and the certified global transfer.
stop_conditions: The ratio is already sharp in the source.
focuses.novelty_status: The ratio theorem is internal; the global proportion is attributed to Wang's framework and sits about 2.9e-8 above his printed C_0+delta_0.

focuses.title: Localized Levinson-Conrey detector
focuses.target: Localize Levinson's method with general Q to (T,T+T^theta] and transfer the distinct sign-change density through the parity product.
focuses.value: Moved the onset from 0.5458838 to 0.534 with about 1000 times the density at theta=0.5459.
focuses.success_gate: Proved localized moment for nu<theta-1/2, counting lemma, certified detectors, onset below 0.5458838.
stop_conditions: The localized moment fails for general Q.
focuses.novelty_status: No short-interval Levinson paper with general Q located through 2026-09-27; external review pending. The onset uses Wang's pair theorem.

focuses.title: Short-interval onset toward theta>1/2
focuses.target: Lower the simple-critical positivity onset below 0.534, ideally to every theta>1/2, or prove a documented barrier for the available methods.
focuses.value: Positivity for every theta>1/2 would close the short-interval question for these methods; a documented barrier prevents wasted rounds.
focuses.success_gate: A proved onset below 0.534 with certified constants, or a written obstruction for the general-Q short-window moment (RH-027) plus closure notes RH-034 and RH-035.
stop_conditions: RH-031 shows that no partial Steuding extension moves the onset.
RH-027 hits a summed dual-moment main term (Tang-type) or an off-diagonal main term not uniform in the shifts (Steuding-type).
Three consecutive experiments fail to move the onset.
RH-038 finds that the asymptotic large sieve does not extend to short t-ranges of length T/H with the needed moduli range.
focuses.novelty_status: 2026-09-27 sweep and RH-030 full-text verification found no external onset below 0.534.
focuses.manuscript_route: short-interval-levinson next version if the gain uses the Levinson detector; a new paper only if a general-Q short-window moment theorem is proved
focuses.first_bounded_action: RH-038: locate or derive an asymptotic evaluation of the dual family sum_h a_h sum_{chi mod h} int G A_chi |L(1/2+it,chi)|^2 (Conrey-Iwaniec-Soundararajan asymptotic large sieve type) with a range beyond theta-1/2. EXP-011 closed linear refinements; EXP-012 showed the Tang route with trivial or large-sieve bounds reproduces only nu<theta-1/2.

focuses.title: Unconditional Cohn-Elkies kernels
focuses.target: Decide whether the Lamzouri/Weil-form framework admits kernels with r-hat<=0 beyond the support without RH.
focuses.value: A yes would raise the global simple-critical constant by about 0.0067; a no explains why the 2026 unconditional constants equal the RH bandlimited constants.
focuses.success_gate: A lemma controlling the sign-constrained tail with certified constants, or a proof that the term is uncontrolled.
stop_conditions: The invariant reproduction of 0.67250, 0.6727, 0.6792 and 0.55019 fails.
The tail term needs localization hypotheses.
No Gram representation exists for a kernel without compactly supported eta, as Lamzouri's Proposition 2.1 requires.
focuses.novelty_status: Closed 2026-09-27: Lamzouri's framework sees the pair sum only as a norm with compactly supported eta, and F has no unconditional sign beyond the support (route preflights, RH-032).
focuses.manuscript_route: sharp-three-point-kernel next version for a global gain; research record for a negative answer
focuses.first_bounded_action: RH-032 invariant reproduction and the Cheer-Goldston discrepancy.

focuses.title: Mixed-Gram fixed-certificate parameter audit
focuses.target: Improve and cap the block/clipping parameters for the fixed seven-point inputs of arXiv:2609.33043v1.
focuses.value: An exact comparison with a new external result, a small auditable constant gain, and an explicit ceiling that prevents repeated parameter sweeps.
focuses.success_gate: Rational reproduction, a strictly stronger parameter choice, and an algebraic cap for all larger integer blocks.
stop_conditions: The imported certificate cannot be bound to its source.
No compatible rational parameter improves the source choice.
focuses.novelty_status: Source-based arithmetic optimization; no new matrix method, full certificate replay or external priority claim.
focuses.manuscript_route: research-record; a new analytic theorem or substantial new certificate is required for a manuscript
focuses.first_bounded_action: EXP-013, eliminate the off-line-pair residual against the clipping threshold before any numerical sweep.
